info.title: hideout-api
info.description: REST contract for hideout-web. Generated from src/contracts/http; do not edit.

session.name: hideout_session
session.description: httpOnly session cookie, named __Host-hideout_session over HTTPS.

code.description: One of: BAD_REQUEST, INVALID_JSON, UNAUTHENTICATED, INVALID_SIGNATURE, FORBIDDEN, ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED, UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT_TYPE, NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT, CHANNEL_NAME_TAKEN, CHANNEL_LIMIT_REACHED, LAST_TEXT_CHANNEL, CHANNEL_ORDER_STALE, CHANNEL_NOT_TEXT, CHANNEL_NOT_VOICE, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED, ALREADY_MEMBER, INVITE_ALREADY_PENDING, USER_BANNED, BANNED, INVITE_ALREADY_RESPONDED, INVITE_EXPIRED, INVITE_REVOKED, INVITE_USED_UP, OWNER_PROTECTED, PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, VALIDATION_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, INTERNAL.

AuthRedirectError.description: Value of the `auth_error` query param when the Steam callback redirects back to WEB_ORIGIN. STEAM_LOGIN_FAILED: Steam rejected or we could not verify the sign-in. LOGIN_STATE_MISMATCH: the sign-in was not started from this browser (or took over 10 minutes). STEAM_UNAVAILABLE: Steam could not be reached. LOGIN_FAILED: our server failed to create the session. RATE_LIMITED: too many sign-in attempts from this network; try again in a minute.

expiresAt.description: When the token expires. Refresh about a minute before.

RoomName.description: Room name: 1–48 UTF-16 code units after trimming surrounding whitespace. Normalized to Unicode NFC before the length check (composed and decomposed forms are the same name). Must contain at least one visible letter, number, symbol, or punctuation mark. Outside RGI emoji, format characters (Unicode Cf, e.g. zero-width and bidi control characters, soft hyphen, U+FEFF, tag characters), control characters (Cc), line and paragraph separators (Zl, Zp), and the blank-looking U+115F, U+1160, U+3164, U+FFA0, and U+2800 are rejected; U+200D zero-width joiner is allowed for emoji.

emoji.description: Exactly one emoji (RGI emoji sequence, at most 16 UTF-16 code units).

RoomIconInput.description: The room icon to set. Only `emoji` is accepted today; more kinds may be added later.

UpdateRoomBody.description: At least one of `name` or `icon` is required.

defaultChannelId.description: Lowest-position text channel (where "You'll land in #general" points); null if there is none.

channels.description: Live channels: text first, then voice, each by position.

members.description: All members: owner, then admins, then members, each by name.

ChannelName.description: Channel name: 1–32 UTF-16 code units after trimming surrounding whitespace. Unique among the room’s live channels of the same type, ignoring case. Normalized to Unicode NFC before the length check (composed and decomposed forms are the same name). Must contain at least one visible letter, number, symbol, or punctuation mark. Outside RGI emoji, format characters (Unicode Cf, e.g. zero-width and bidi control characters, soft hyphen, U+FEFF, tag characters), control characters (Cc), line and paragraph separators (Zl, Zp), and the blank-looking U+115F, U+1160, U+3164, U+FFA0, and U+2800 are rejected; U+200D zero-width joiner is allowed for emoji.

channelIds.description: Every live channel of `type` in the room, each exactly once, in the new order (first = top).

data.description: Live channels of one type, by position.

Message.description: `author` is null only when the author’s profile was deleted; former members keep their author. `editedAt` is null until the first edit.

MessageBody.description: Message text: 1–2000 Unicode code points (counted after CRLF → LF), not trimmed. Must be well-formed UTF-16 (no lone surrogates) and contain at least one visible character: not whitespace, a format character (Unicode Cf, e.g. zero-width or bidi controls), a combining mark on its own (Mn, Me), U+2800, or the Hangul fillers U+115F, U+1160, U+3164, U+FFA0. Format characters, including bidi controls, are allowed alongside visible text, so render bodies bidi-isolated (e.g. `<bdi>` or `dir="auto"` with `unicode-bidi: isolate`). Control characters (Unicode Cc) are rejected except tab and line feed; CRLF is stored as LF and a lone CR is rejected.

InviteExpiresIn.description: How long a link invite stays valid. `never` = no expiry.

InviteMaxUses.description: How many people can join with a link invite.

CreateInviteBody.description: `link`: a shareable link (optional expiry and max uses). `direct`: an invite to one Steam account, single use, expiring after 7 days.

InviteStatus.description: Computed when read. `accepted`/`declined` only apply to direct invites; an accepted or declined invite that was later revoked stays `accepted`/`declined`. More values may be added.

inviteeSteamId.description: Set for direct invites, null for links.

Invite.description: An invite as its room sees it. Never includes the link token: it is shown once, when the link is created. `createdBy` is null once the creator’s profile was deleted.

token.description: Link invites only: the raw token. Shown only in this response; it can’t be retrieved later.

url.description: Link invites only: `WEB_ORIGIN/invite/<token>`, ready to share.

InvitePreviewInviter.description: Who created a link invite, as the public preview shows them (no profile id).

invitedBy.description: Null once the creator’s profile was deleted.

status.description: `already_member`: you were already in the room (e.g. a retry); no use was consumed.
`already_member`: you were already in the room, or this is a retry of an accept that succeeded.

InboxInvite.description: A pending direct invite; the same shape as the `invite:received` event payload.

role.description: The new role. Ownership only moves via `POST /api/rooms/{roomId}/transfer-ownership`.

userId.description: Profile id of the member who becomes the owner.
Profile id of the member to ban.

reason.description: Optional note for the room's owner and admins, 1–200 characters after trimming. Control characters (Unicode Cc, including line breaks) are rejected. Omit it rather than sending an empty string. Never shown to the banned person.

user.description: The banned Steam account’s profile; null once it was deleted.

bannedBy.description: Who issued the ban; null once their profile was deleted.

Ban.description: A Steam account banned from a room. Permanent until an owner or admin lifts it.

roomName.description: The LiveKit room the token joins (`voice_<channelId>`). Informational; the token already names it.

expiresAt.description: When the token stops being usable to join (60 seconds after issue). Fetch a token right before connecting, never ahead of time. Once connected, LiveKit refreshes it automatically; after a disconnect, fetch a new one to rejoin.

participants.description: Room members currently in the voice channel, in the order they joined.

data.description: One entry per live voice channel of the room (empty channels included), by channel position.

404.description: Not generated.
Not generated.

get.summary: Swagger UI for this REST contract

get.description: Navigate the browser here (a full page load, not fetch). Sets a short-lived state cookie and redirects to Steam. Steam then sends the browser to /api/auth/steam/callback.

302.description: Redirect to the Steam sign-in page, or to WEB_ORIGIN/?auth_error=RATE_LIMITED when rate limited.

get.description: Steam redirects the browser here; clients never call it directly. On success it sets the session cookie and redirects to WEB_ORIGIN/. On failure it redirects to WEB_ORIGIN/?auth_error=<code>; see the AuthRedirectError schema for the codes.

302.description: Redirect back to hideout-web: WEB_ORIGIN/ on success, WEB_ORIGIN/?auth_error=<AuthRedirectError> on failure.

schema.description: Clears the login state cookie; on success also sets the httpOnly session cookie (7 days).

Set-Cookie.description: Clears the login state cookie; on success also sets the httpOnly session cookie (7 days).

post.description: Deletes the current session and clears the cookie. Send `Content-Type: application/json` (no body needed) with credentials; the CSRF check requires it.

403.description: Origin or Content-Type check failed.

post.description: Deletes all of the current user’s sessions and clears the cookie. Same request rules as logout. Afterwards the API broadcasts `session:expired` (empty payload) on the user’s `user:<profileId>` Realtime topic so other open tabs and devices can sign out; delivery is best-effort and never fails this request. Single-device logout does not broadcast.

403.description: Origin or Content-Type check failed.

get.description: The signed-in user’s own profile. Call on load with credentials: 200 means signed in, 401 means signed out. Sent with `Cache-Control: no-store`.

A short-lived (15 minute) Supabase JWT for joining private Realtime channels. Call `supabase.realtime.setAuth(token)` and fetch a new one about a minute before `expiresAt`. The token carries no room claims: which topics can be joined is decided by current room membership. Sent with `Cache-Control: no-store`. Rate limited to 30 requests per hour per user.

post.description: Creates a room owned by the caller, with a `general` text channel and a `voice` voice channel. Not idempotent: disable the create button while the request is pending. Rate limited to 10/hour per user. Writes need `Content-Type: application/json` (even with no body) and credentials; the CSRF check requires it.

403.description: Origin or Content-Type check failed (send `Content-Type: application/json` from WEB_ORIGIN).

get.description: Rooms the caller belongs to, oldest membership first. Cursor-paginated: pass `nextCursor` back as `cursor` until it is null. Sent with `Cache-Control: no-store`.
The room, the caller’s role, its channels, default channel, and members. Non-members get 404, so room existence never leaks. Sent with `Cache-Control: no-store`.

404.description: Room not found, deleted, or you are not a member (non-members always get 404).

patch.summary: Rename a room or change its icon
patch.description: Owner or admin only. Broadcasts `room:updated` on `room:<roomId>`. Non-members get 404. Rate limited to 30/hour per user. Writes need `Content-Type: application/json` (even with no body) and credentials; the CSRF check requires it.

delete.description: Owner only. Soft-deletes the room and its channels, ends its voice sessions, broadcasts `room:deleted` on `room:<roomId>` and `member:removed` on each member’s `user:<profileId>`, revokes the room’s pending invites, and sends `invite:revoked` on the `user:<profileId>` of each signed-in invitee of a pending direct invite it revoked. Non-members get 404. Writes need `Content-Type: application/json` (even with no body) and credentials; the CSRF check requires it.

post.description: Owner or admin only. The new channel is appended to the end of its type. A room holds at most 50 live channels. Broadcasts `channel:created` on `room:<roomId>`. Non-members get 404. Not idempotent: disable the create button while the request is pending. Channel writes are rate limited to 60/hour per user. Writes need `Content-Type: application/json` (even with no body) and credentials; the CSRF check requires it.

403.description: Origin or Content-Type check failed (send `Content-Type: application/json` from WEB_ORIGIN). Or the caller is a plain member (owner or admin required).

409.description: `CHANNEL_NAME_TAKEN`: a live channel of this type already has this name (ignoring case). `CHANNEL_LIMIT_REACHED`: the room already has the maximum number of channels.

patch.description: Owner or admin only. Broadcasts `channel:updated` on `room:<roomId>`. Non-members get 404. Channel writes are rate limited to 60/hour per user. Writes need `Content-Type: application/json` (even with no body) and credentials; the CSRF check requires it.

delete.description: Owner or admin only. Soft-deletes the channel; its messages are kept but no longer reachable. Deleting a voice channel disconnects everyone in it. The last text channel of a room can’t be deleted. Broadcasts `channel:deleted` on `room:<roomId>`. Non-members get 404. Channel writes are rate limited to 60/hour per user. Writes need `Content-Type: application/json` (even with no body) and credentials; the CSRF check requires it.

403.description: Origin or Content-Type check failed (send `Content-Type: application/json` from WEB_ORIGIN). Or the caller is a plain member (owner or admin required).

409.description: `LAST_TEXT_CHANNEL`: this is the room’s only text channel.

put.summary: Reorder a room’s channels of one type
put.description: Owner or admin only. `channelIds` must list every live channel of `type` in the room exactly once; if the list is stale (a channel was created or deleted meanwhile) the response is 409 `CHANNEL_ORDER_STALE`: reload the room and try again. Broadcasts `channel:reordered` on `room:<roomId>`. Non-members get 404. Channel writes are rate limited to 60/hour per user. Writes need `Content-Type: application/json` (even with no body) and credentials; the CSRF check requires it.

200.description: The channels of that type in their new order.

403.description: Origin or Content-Type check failed (send `Content-Type: application/json` from WEB_ORIGIN). Or the caller is a plain member (owner or admin required).

404.description: Room not found, deleted, or you are not a member (non-members always get 404).

409.description: `CHANNEL_ORDER_STALE`: the list doesn’t match the room’s live channels of that type. Reload and retry.

422.description: Invalid type, or channelIds empty, too long, malformed, or repeated.

post.description: Any member of the channel’s room can send in a text channel. Broadcasts `message:created` on `channel:<channelId>`, also for idempotent replays, so `message:created` may be delivered more than once: dedupe by id. Non-members get 404. Send an `Idempotency-Key` so retries are safe. Sending, editing, and deleting share one rate limit: 10 per 10 seconds per user. Writes need `Content-Type: application/json` (even with no body) and credentials; the CSRF check requires it.

schema.description: Recommended: a fresh random key (e.g. a UUID) per message, reused on every retry of that message. A retry with the same key returns the original message (200, `Idempotent-Replayed: true`) instead of posting it twice. Reusing a key for a different message (another body or channel), or after that message was deleted or edited to a different body, is 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`.

parameters.description: Recommended: a fresh random key (e.g. a UUID) per message, reused on every retry of that message. A retry with the same key returns the original message (200, `Idempotent-Replayed: true`) instead of posting it twice. Reusing a key for a different message (another body or channel), or after that message was deleted or edited to a different body, is 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

200.description: A retry with an Idempotency-Key already used for this message: the original message, not posted again.

409.description: `CHANNEL_NOT_TEXT`: the channel is a voice channel. `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`: the key was used for a different message (another body or channel), or that message was deleted or edited to a different body since.

get.summary: List messages in a text channel
get.description: Any member of the channel’s room. Without `after`: history, newest first; pass `nextCursor` back as `cursor` for older messages until it is null. With `after=<messageId>` (after reconnecting): messages oldest first, starting 5 seconds before that message, so some may repeat: dedupe by id. Pass `nextCursor` back as `cursor` (alone) for newer messages until it is null. Delivery and backfill are best-effort. Backfill returns only live messages created after the window start; edits and deletes of older messages that happened while you were disconnected are not recovered (reload history for that). Deleted messages are never returned. Non-members get 404. Sent with `Cache-Control: no-store`. Rate limited to 120/minute per user.

schema.description: Opaque `nextCursor` from the previous page; continues in the same direction. Not with `after`.

parameters.description: Opaque `nextCursor` from the previous page; continues in the same direction. Not with `after`.
parameters.name: cursor

schema.description: Backfill after reconnecting: the id of the last message you have. Returns messages oldest first, starting 5 seconds before that message (so some may repeat: dedupe by id), excluding it. Not with `cursor`.

parameters.description: Backfill after reconnecting: the id of the last message you have. Returns messages oldest first, starting 5 seconds before that message (so some may repeat: dedupe by id), excluding it. Not with `cursor`.
parameters.name: after

409.description: `CHANNEL_NOT_TEXT`: the channel is a voice channel.

422.description: Invalid cursor or limit, both `cursor` and `after`, or `after` is not a message in this channel.

patch.description: Author only (no time limit). Sets `editedAt`. Broadcasts `message:updated` on `channel:<channelId>`. Non-members get 404. Sending, editing, and deleting share one rate limit: 10 per 10 seconds per user. Writes need `Content-Type: application/json` (even with no body) and credentials; the CSRF check requires it.

delete.description: The author, or an owner or admin of the room. Soft-deletes the message; it is no longer returned. Broadcasts `message:deleted` on `channel:<channelId>`. Non-members get 404. Not idempotent: a retried DELETE of a message that was already deleted returns 404; treat that as done. Sending, editing, and deleting share one rate limit: 10 per 10 seconds per user. Writes need `Content-Type: application/json` (even with no body) and credentials; the CSRF check requires it.

403.description: Origin or Content-Type check failed (send `Content-Type: application/json` from WEB_ORIGIN). Or the caller is a plain member who isn’t the author.

404.description: Message not found or deleted, its channel or room is deleted, or you are not a member of its room (non-members always get 404).

post.description: `link` (owner or admin only; a plain member gets 403 `FORBIDDEN`): returns the invite plus `token` and `url`; the token is shown only in this response, so share it now. `direct` (any member): invites one Steam account (single use, expires after 7 days); if that person has signed in, `invite:received` is broadcast on their `user:<profileId>`, otherwise it appears in their inbox when they sign in. An expired pending direct invite is replaced automatically. Not idempotent. Non-members get 404. Rate limited to 20/hour per user. Writes need `Content-Type: application/json` (even with no body) and credentials; the CSRF check requires it.

201.description: The new invite (with `token` and `url` for links).

403.description: Origin or Content-Type check failed (send `Content-Type: application/json` from WEB_ORIGIN). Or a plain member tried to create a `link` invite (owner or admin required).

404.description: Room not found, deleted, or you are not a member (non-members always get 404).

409.description: `ALREADY_MEMBER`: that Steam account is already in the room. `INVITE_ALREADY_PENDING`: an unexpired direct invite to that Steam account is pending; revoke it first. `USER_BANNED`: that Steam account is banned from the room; lift the ban first.

422.description: Invalid body (kind, expiresIn, maxUses, or steamId).

get.description: Owners and admins see every invite in the room; members see only the invites they created. Newest first, cursor-paginated: pass `nextCursor` back as `cursor` until it is null. With `status=active` a page can hold fewer than `limit` items (even none) while `nextCursor` is not null; keep going until it is null. Non-members get 404. Sent with `Cache-Control: no-store`. Rate limited to 60/minute per user.

schema.description: `active` (default): only invites that can still be used. `all`: every invite.

parameters.description: `active` (default): only invites that can still be used. `all`: every invite.
parameters.name: status

404.description: Room not found, deleted, or you are not a member (non-members always get 404).

delete.description: The invite’s creator, or an owner or admin of its room. Idempotent: revoking a revoked invite is 204. Revoking an accepted invite never removes the member. For a pending direct invite to someone who has signed in, broadcasts `invite:revoked` on their `user:<profileId>`. Non-members of the invite’s room get 404. Rate limited to 60/hour per user. Writes need `Content-Type: application/json` (even with no body) and credentials; the CSRF check requires it.

403.description: Origin or Content-Type check failed (send `Content-Type: application/json` from WEB_ORIGIN). Or the caller is a plain member who didn’t create the invite.

get.description: Public (no session needed): what the invite page shows before joining. Returns 404 with the same body for every unusable invite (malformed or unknown token, revoked, expired, used up, deleted room), so it reveals nothing about invalid links. Sent with `Cache-Control: no-store`. Rate limited to 60/minute per IP.

post.summary: Join a room with a link invite
post.description: Joins the invite’s room as a member and returns the room. Idempotent by design: redeeming again (or a retry) returns `already_member` without using up the invite. On join, broadcasts `member:joined` on `room:<roomId>`. 410 codes: `INVITE_REVOKED`, `INVITE_EXPIRED`, `INVITE_USED_UP`. A caller banned from the room gets 403 `BANNED`. Redeem, accept, and decline share one rate limit: 10/minute per user. Writes need `Content-Type: application/json` (even with no body) and credentials; the CSRF check requires it.

schema.description: The link invite token (43 base64url characters). A malformed token is a 404, like an unknown one.

parameters.description: The link invite token (43 base64url characters). A malformed token is a 404, like an unknown one.
parameters.name: token

403.description: Origin or Content-Type check failed (send `Content-Type: application/json` from WEB_ORIGIN). Or `BANNED`: you are banned from this room.

404.description: Malformed or unknown token, or the room was deleted.

get.description: Pending, unexpired direct invites to the caller’s Steam account in live rooms, newest first (at most 100). Keep it current with `invite:received` and `invite:revoked` on `user:<profileId>`. Sent with `Cache-Control: no-store`. Rate limited to 60/minute per user.

post.description: Joins the room and returns it. Idempotent: retrying an accept that succeeded returns `already_member`. On join, broadcasts `member:joined` on `room:<roomId>`. Invites addressed to someone else are 404. A caller banned from the room gets 403 `BANNED`; declining still works. Redeem, accept, and decline share one rate limit: 10/minute per user. Writes need `Content-Type: application/json` (even with no body) and credentials; the CSRF check requires it.

403.description: Origin or Content-Type check failed (send `Content-Type: application/json` from WEB_ORIGIN). Or `BANNED`: you are banned from this room.

404.description: Invite not found, not addressed to you, or its room was deleted.

409.description: `INVITE_ALREADY_RESPONDED`: the invite was already declined, or accepted and you are no longer a member.

post.description: Declines the invite; nobody is notified. Idempotent: declining a declined invite is 204. Invites addressed to someone else are 404. Redeem, accept, and decline share one rate limit: 10/minute per user. Writes need `Content-Type: application/json` (even with no body) and credentials; the CSRF check requires it.

403.description: Origin or Content-Type check failed (send `Content-Type: application/json` from WEB_ORIGIN).

404.description: Invite not found, not addressed to you, or its room was deleted.

delete.description: Any member except the owner. Broadcasts `member:left` on `room:<roomId>` and disconnects the member from the room’s voice channels. Their pending invites in this room are revoked, as are pending direct invites addressed to them; each signed-in invitee of a revoked direct invite gets `invite:revoked` on their `user:<profileId>`. The owner gets 409 `OWNER_PROTECTED`: transfer ownership or delete the room first. Non-members get 404. Leave, remove, change role, and transfer ownership share one rate limit: 30/hour per user. Writes need `Content-Type: application/json` (even with no body) and credentials; the CSRF check requires it.

403.description: Origin or Content-Type check failed (send `Content-Type: application/json` from WEB_ORIGIN).

404.description: Room not found, deleted, or you are not a member (non-members always get 404).

409.description: `OWNER_PROTECTED`: the room owner can't leave or be removed; transfer ownership or delete the room first.

delete.description: The owner removes anyone except themself; an admin removes plain members only. Broadcasts `member:left` on `room:<roomId>` and disconnects the member from the room’s voice channels. Their pending invites in this room are revoked, as are pending direct invites addressed to them; each signed-in invitee of a revoked direct invite gets `invite:revoked` on their `user:<profileId>`. Also broadcasts `member:removed` on the removed member’s `user:<profileId>`, so their client leaves the room. If `userId` is the caller’s own id, this behaves exactly like leaving (`DELETE /api/rooms/{roomId}/members/me`: same rules, no `member:removed`). Removing the owner is 409 `OWNER_PROTECTED`. Non-members get 404. Leave, remove, change role, and transfer ownership share one rate limit: 30/hour per user. Writes need `Content-Type: application/json` (even with no body) and credentials; the CSRF check requires it.

schema.description: Profile id of the member. A malformed id is a 404, like an unknown one.

parameters.description: Profile id of the member. A malformed id is a 404, like an unknown one.

409.description: `OWNER_PROTECTED`: the room owner can't leave or be removed; transfer ownership or delete the room first.

patch.description: Owner only: makes a member an admin or an admin a plain member. Broadcasts `member:role_changed` on `room:<roomId>`. The owner can’t change their own role (422); ownership moves only via transfer. Non-members get 404. If the response is a 5xx, the change may have been applied; refetch the room before retrying. Leave, remove, change role, and transfer ownership share one rate limit: 30/hour per user. Writes need `Content-Type: application/json` (even with no body) and credentials; the CSRF check requires it.

schema.description: Profile id of the member. A malformed id is a 404, like an unknown one.

200.description: The member with their new role.

403.description: Origin or Content-Type check failed (send `Content-Type: application/json` from WEB_ORIGIN). Or the caller is not the owner.

404.description: Room not found, deleted, or you are not a member (non-members always get 404); or the target is not a member (or the userId is malformed).

422.description: Invalid role, or the owner targeted themself.

post.description: Owner only: makes another member the owner; the caller becomes an admin. Broadcasts two `member:role_changed` events on `room:<roomId>` (the caller → `admin`, the new owner → `owner`). Returns the room as the caller now sees it. Non-members get 404. If the response is a 5xx, the change may have been applied; refetch the room before retrying. Leave, remove, change role, and transfer ownership share one rate limit: 30/hour per user. Writes need `Content-Type: application/json` (even with no body) and credentials; the CSRF check requires it.

200.description: The room, with the caller now an admin.

403.description: Origin or Content-Type check failed (send `Content-Type: application/json` from WEB_ORIGIN). Or the caller is not the owner.

404.description: Room not found, deleted, or you are not a member (non-members always get 404); or the new owner is not a member.

422.description: Invalid body, or `userId` is the caller’s own id.

post.description: Owner or admin: removes a member and bans their Steam account from the room until the ban is lifted. The owner bans anyone except themself; an admin bans plain members only. Same effects as removing the member (`member:left` on `room:<roomId>`, disconnect from the room’s voice channels, their pending invites in the room revoked, as are pending direct invites addressed to them, with `invite:revoked` to each signed-in invitee), and `member:removed` on the banned member’s `user:<profileId>` carries `banned: true`. While banned, the account can’t join with a link (403 `BANNED`), accept a direct invite (403 `BANNED`), or be sent one (409 `USER_BANNED`). Not idempotent: the target must still be a member. Non-members get 404. If the server can’t read the stored ban back after writing it, it still answers 201, with `createdAt` from the API’s clock (approximate) and `bannedBy` possibly null; the ban list has the stored values. Ban and unban share the membership-write rate limit (with leave, remove, change role, and transfer ownership): 30/hour per user. Writes need `Content-Type: application/json` (even with no body) and credentials; the CSRF check requires it.

403.description: Origin or Content-Type check failed (send `Content-Type: application/json` from WEB_ORIGIN). Or the caller is a plain member (owner or admin required). Or an admin tried to ban an admin.

404.description: Room not found, deleted, or you are not a member (non-members always get 404); or `userId` is not a member.

409.description: `OWNER_PROTECTED`: the room owner can't be banned.

422.description: Invalid body (`userId` or `reason`), or `userId` is the caller’s own id (at `body.userId`).

get.description: Owner or admin: every active ban in the room, newest first, cursor-paginated: pass `nextCursor` back as `cursor` until it is null. Non-members get 404. Sent with `Cache-Control: no-store`. Rate limited to 60/minute per user.

403.description: The caller is a plain member (owner or admin required).

404.description: Room not found, deleted, or you are not a member (non-members always get 404).

delete.description: Owner or admin. The owner or any admin can lift any ban, whoever issued it (including a ban the owner issued, or one on an admin the owner banned); this is deliberate. The account can then be invited again; it does not rejoin automatically. No broadcast. Non-members get 404. Ban and unban share the membership-write rate limit (with leave, remove, change role, and transfer ownership): 30/hour per user. Writes need `Content-Type: application/json` (even with no body) and credentials; the CSRF check requires it.

403.description: Origin or Content-Type check failed (send `Content-Type: application/json` from WEB_ORIGIN). Or the caller is a plain member (owner or admin required).

404.description: Room not found, deleted, or you are not a member (non-members always get 404); or that SteamID is not banned (or is malformed).

post.description: Any member of the channel’s room. Returns a LiveKit token (identity = your profile id) that can join this voice channel for 60 seconds; connect immediately. It allows publishing your microphone only (no camera, screen share, or data messages). When you are removed from the room, banned, or the channel or room is deleted, you are disconnected and tokens issued before then stop working (so a member who leaves and is re-invited may need to wait about a minute to rejoin that voice channel). No request body: send `Content-Type: application/json` (the CSRF check requires it) with an empty body or `{}`; any body is ignored, but it must be valid JSON if present. Sent with `Cache-Control: no-store`. Rate limited to 20/minute per user (counted before the membership check). Non-members get 404.

400.description: `INVALID_JSON`: a body was sent and it is not valid JSON.

403.description: Origin or Content-Type check failed (send `Content-Type: application/json` from WEB_ORIGIN).

404.description: Channel not found or deleted, its room is deleted, or you are not a member of its room (non-members always get 404).

409.description: `CHANNEL_NOT_VOICE`: the channel is a text channel.

get.summary: Who is in each voice channel
get.description: Any member. The current participants of every live voice channel in the room, read from LiveKit. Load it when opening a room and after reconnecting to Realtime; afterwards `voice:participants` on `room:<roomId>` carries the full list for one channel whenever it changes (replace, don’t merge). A channel whose participants LiveKit can’t list right now is returned with an empty list. Rate limited to 60/minute per user (counted before the membership check). Non-members get 404.

404.description: Room not found, deleted, or you are not a member (non-members always get 404).

post.description: Called by LiveKit, not by browsers. Configure `API_URL/api/livekit/webhook` as the webhook URL in LiveKit Cloud. The body is a LiveKit `WebhookEvent` sent as `application/webhook+json`, signed by the JWT in the `Authorization` header (checked against the raw body with the LiveKit API secret). Unsigned or tampered requests get 401 and change nothing. A verified event gets 200, even one that is ignored or fails internally (failures are logged), so LiveKit doesn’t retry it; the exception is a `participant_joined` whose membership can’t be checked (database unavailable), which gets 503 so LiveKit retries it. `participant_joined`, `participant_left`, `participant_connection_aborted`, and `room_finished` on `voice_<channelId>` rooms broadcast `voice:participants`. A participant who joins without being a member of the channel’s room (or joins a non-canonical `voice_` room) is removed from LiveKit, and every participant list read removes connected non-members. Rate limited to 600/minute per IP.

schema.description: LiveKit `WebhookEvent` (protobuf JSON). Only the fields Hideout reads are listed.

200.description: Verified and acknowledged (handled or deliberately ignored).

401.description: `INVALID_SIGNATURE`: missing or invalid `Authorization` signature, a body that doesn’t match it, or a Content-Type other than `application/webhook+json`.

503.description: `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`: a `participant_joined` could not be checked against room membership; LiveKit retries.
